newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks rally by lunch on bargain hunting.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks rally by lunch on bargain hunting.

text.p: Bargain hunters, buoyed by a 50-billion-baht market support fund being contributed by commercial banks, bought big capitalised stocks and pushed the market up 1.87 percent by lunch, brokers said on Monday.
"Plans to set up a stock market support fund boosted sentiment and prompted local investors to focus blue chips this morning," said Thanadech Mahapokai of Book Club Finance and Securities.
The SET index rose 10.49 points to 571.68 on moderate 2.03 billion baht half-day turnover.

The rally followed Finance Minister Amnuay Viravan's announcement on Saturday that commercial banks volunteered to pool the support fund to help shore up the market after it tumbled to near an eight-year low last week.
Most key sectors advanced. Banks led the advance, rising 3.39 percent, the communication sector gained 1.57 percent, and the finance counter surged 5.27 percent.
Bangkok Bank topped the active list, rising three baht to 150, Shinawatra Computer added four to 112.
